newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy urges restraint in Middle East.
newsitem.headline: Italy urges restraint in Middle East.

text.p: Italy urged Israel and the Palestinian leadership on Wednesday to show restraint after the bloodiest clashes in the West Bank since PLO rule began two years ago.
A foreign ministry statement said the government was following news of the clashes with concern and hoped "that such deplorable incidents will not ignite a new spiral of violence in the region".

"Italy...invites the parties not to undertake actions which could prejudice the final outcome of Israeli-Palestinian negotiations, particularly on such delicate issues as Jerusalem," the statement said.
Italy was asking all sides to "show proof of moderation by promptly resuming talks on the application of accords already reached and to relaunch the peace process," it added.

Israeli soldiers shot dead three Palestinian policemen and a civilian on Wednesday during widespread Palestinian protests against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's decison to open a tunnel in Jerusalem near Islam's third holiest shrine.

Netanyahu said he had merely implemented a previous Labour government decision to open a second entrance to a tunnel beside the Dome of the Rock and al-Aqsa mosque complex, saying it made an important archaeological site more accessible to tourists.
